summary: The narrator, frustrated with his friends and his own sense of helplessness after work with Halliday, drives aimlessly through the city and then breaks into Rita Martinez's condo to look for clues to where she fled. He finds her shelves dusty where items were removed, despite her denial that anything was missing. Outside, a stooped old neighbor asks whether he is Rita's friend or daughter, mentions government people who came asking about her after another woman was 'snatched,' and claims the government murdered Martinez's family, which the narrator finds unlikely.
one_line: A frustrated narrator breaks into Rita Martinez's condo searching for her, then meets a suspicious old neighbor who mentions government agents.
key_facts: The narrator drives around the city with aimless vengeance, going in circles as if on a mission to wear out the car.
The narrator runs out of gas, refills the tank, and keeps driving.
The narrator thinks finding Martinez is the only problem he has any shot at solving right now.
The narrator drives to Martinez's condo and breaks in to look for clues about where she ran.
Martinez's living room shelves have dust fronting empty spaces, suggesting items were removed.
Martinez denied anything was missing, but the narrator concludes she was clearly lying.
Arthur is described as far more observant than the narrator.
The building has a small paved back area with a high fence, lawn furniture, and a portable fire pit.
An old man with a cane, scraggly white hair, and half-missing yellow teeth approaches the narrator behind the building.
The old man asks, 'Are you a friend of Rita's?' and then whether she is in some sort of trouble.
The old man says government people were at the building asking about Rita when 'the other lady got snatched.'
The old man says he did not tell the government people anything.
The old man claims 'I think the government murdered' Martinez's family, because 'they watch us.'
The narrator says he is not Martinez's daughter.
The narrator finds it highly unlikely the government randomly murdered Martinez's family.
